body.name: E_O
body.def: \(\mathcal E(\mathcal O)\) contains the endpoint positions on observed--observed adjacencies of the full MAGs \(M_k(\eta)\), \(k=0,\ldots,K\). Endpoints at \(\zeta_k\) are retained in \(\mathcal O\) as constraints on the fiber but are excluded from this reported endpoint domain.
